items.question: When might ordering updates per key avoid the cost of one global sequence?

section_new.excerpt: # Resequencer > **Pattern atlas:** > [Resequencer](../../v11-pattern-atlas/c03-messaging-integration/resequencer.md#resequencer) — decision conditions and contraindications. This page owns the bounded technical note moved from the [consumer requirements and messaging families page](message-selection.md#resequencer) on 2026-10-29. The other ownership notes remain on the chapter page. **Decision.** Use a resequencer only when the message contract declares a required order, a reliable sequence domain, and a bounded buffer whose gap timeout and late-message disposition have owners. Partition by key instead when global order is unnecessary; when the buffer cannot be bounded, reject the resequence
